name: Invoice
description: Invoice references and dates, seller and customer details, itemized charges, and a clear amount due with optional payment instructions and recorded payments.
structure: The opening pairs issue and optional due dates with a prominent calculated amount due, below the title and invoice reference. An optional logo slot sits at the upper right.
Seller and customer details sit side by side, followed by line items with repeating table headers.
Totals align on the right. Supplied payments reduce the calculated balance; the same amount due appears in the opening and the totals.
Optional payment instructions, payment reference, and supporting notes follow the charges. Each invoice owns its data and longer content flows naturally.
